L40: ### voice-first hardware interface for human-agent interaction
L41: 
L42: antimattr builds a voice-first hardware interface for human-agent interaction that includes a ring and a pair of earphones. Designed to make more of your voice, the ring can record and summarise your conversations, capture thoughts on the go, or control your agents. The earphones use proprietary voice isolation technology to block out background noise entirely, so you can take a clear call from a loud pub or dictate with real accuracy.
